about.text: Bog butter is an ancient waxy substance found buried in peat bogs, particularly in Ireland and Scotland. Likely an old method of making and preserving butter, some tested lumps of bog butter were made of dairy, while others were made of animal fat.

facts.v: Buried in a peat bog; the 2011 Tullamore find lay at 2.3 m, a vessel about 30 cm wide and 60 cm tall holding about 50 kg
Bogs are cold, low in oxygen and acidic
Irish finds from the 1st century AD to the 15th–16th century
Bristol analysis (2003): some samples dairy fat, others animal tallow from adipose tissue
